title: Tooling: 3.09× faster production frame-pair enumeration via eight-bit neighborhoods with identical receipts
body:
## Change and scope

At base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, production `research/complex-frame-pair-decoders/verify.py:frame_pair_solutions` still rebuilt partner lists with nested list comprehensions on every mask. woklerx’s opt-in adapter `research/frame-pair-enumeration-fast-seed93/` (incorporated [#1099](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1099)) already proved an eight-bit neighborhood enumerator with identical PR968 D/E/H receipts. This PR wires that equivalent rewrite into the **production** verifier.

No certificate κ pins change. Same-tip provenance hygiene demotes previous live `usage:input` pins on this verifier to **provenance** (and drops them from live `VERIFY.json` inputs) in:
`complex-puncture-depth-ceiling`, `complex-general-normal-boundary`, `p104-term-shear-seed8be7`, `p104-two-copy-drops`, `e8-connectivity-incidence-boundary`, `selected-p104-port-adapter`, and `p112-batch-centre-floor`. Live pairwise model pins retarget to vendored `baseline.py` for `selected-p104-port-adapter`, `p104-nullpair-compensated-shear-seed318bd5`, and `p104-term-shear-seed8be7`. Legacy WT-hash loaders `p104-asynchronous-carrier-bound`, `root-pair-first-drop-seed48`, `complex-decoder-field-extension-seed44`, and `e8-factor-linear-overcomplete47` likewise load that baseline instead of the rewritten production `verify.py`. The historical opt-in package vendors pairwise bytes as local `baseline.py`.

**Tooling improvement; no new kappa.** Selected frontier untouched.

## Result

On Linux / CPython 3.12.3 with `taskset -c 0`, five alternating fresh-process pairs gave median D/E/H wall time **13.642 → 4.421 s (3.09×)**. Timing is host-descriptive and is not a correctness gate. Receipts stay identical (`frames=1260`, `decoders=7168`, `term_ranks=57344`).

Package: `research/frame-pair-enumeration-production/`.
Tip: `9531cd08327516e677ce3f8eefa4946c0d1dda18`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/frame-pair-enumeration-production/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/frame-pair-enumeration-production/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/frame-pair-enumeration-production
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-puncture-depth-ceiling --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-p104-port-adapter --check-only
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-nullpair-compensated-shear-seed318bd5/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-asynchronous-carrier-bound/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/root-pair-first-drop-seed48/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/root-pair-first-drop-seed48/check_sources.py
python3.12 -I -B research/complex-decoder-field-extension-seed44/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/e8-factor-linear-overcomplete47/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-term-shear-seed8be7/verify.py
python3.12 -B -m unittest tests.test_frame_pair_enumeration_production
taskset -c 0 python3.12 -I -B research/frame-pair-enumeration-production/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_FRAME_PAIR_ENUMERATION_PRODUCTION frames=1260 decoders=7168 term_ranks=57344 corruption=subprocess_failure certs=0 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/frame-pair-enumeration-production outcome=completed
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS
PASS_P104_NULLPAIR_COMPENSATED_SHEAR
PASS_P104_ASYNCHRONOUS_BOUND
PASS_ROOT_PAIR_FIRST_DROP_S48
PASS_COMPLEX_DECODER_FIELD_EXTENSION_S44
PASS_FACTOR_LINEAR_OVERCOMPLETE
PASS_P104_TERM_SHEAR_FINITE_SCREEN
PASS_IDENTICAL_FRAME_PAIR_ENUMERATION_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS
```

Default verify is read-only. Temp-copy omission foil rejects via subprocess failure. Package gates under `-O` still compile checkers with `optimize=0`. Full `make verify`, selected cold replay, Lean, and multiplication-theorem obligations were not rerun for this isolated verifier change.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors (different delivery): woklerx’s `research/frame-pair-enumeration-fast-seed93/` / [#1099](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1099) (opt-in neighborhood enumerator; this is the production wiring), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/756), [CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#2348](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2348) / [#2357](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2357) (same production-promotion + provenance pattern). No competing open PR on production `frame_pair_solutions` at refresh.
